name: sigah
description: SIGAH - Humanitarian Aid Management System for Monteria (monolith)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "pnpm run dev:server" "pnpm run dev:client"
scripts.install:all: pnpm -C server install && pnpm -C client install
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && pnpm run db:up && pnpm run db:migrate && pnpm run db:seed
